customer.consistency: grace after terminal orchestration plus two spaced eligible absence observations
limitations: no backup or physical media inspection
permitted_metadata: deletion tombstone UUIDs outside profile table

orders.consistency: grace after terminal orchestration plus two spaced eligible absence observations
limitations: no backup or physical media inspection
eligible_fields: all non-null fields outside the permitted fact whitelist
orders.retention: facts permitted only under explicit schema policy; not anonymous
orders.strategy: direct customer linkage OR captured order UUIDs; inspect complete JSON row

cache.consistency: grace after terminal orchestration plus two spaced eligible absence observations
limitations: no backup or physical media inspection
cache.retention: profile/derived values absent; exact erasure marker permitted
cache.strategy: bounded SCAN customer:{uuid}* and deletion:customer:{uuid}*; TYPE/GET

search.consistency: grace after terminal orchestration plus two spaced eligible absence observations
limitations: no backup or physical media inspection
eligible_fields: customer-linked documents except exact permitted erasure sentinel
search.retention: only exact erased=true sentinel at subject document ID, version >=2 permitted
search.strategy: direct real-time GET plus _search over IDs and id/customer_id/data.id/data.customer_id

analytics.consistency: grace after terminal orchestration plus two spaced eligible absence observations
limitations: no backup or physical media inspection
eligible_fields: any nested payload value equal to customer UUID
analytics.retention: matching rows absent; no aggregate table exists in current schema
analytics.strategy: direct UUID linkage OR exact recursive JSON UUID match

event_history.consistency: grace after terminal orchestration plus two spaced eligible absence observations
limitations: no backup or physical media inspection
event_history.retention: source payload absent; typed identifier-only control messages and receipt metadata permitted
event_history.strategy: UUID/aggregate linkage and strict envelope/receipt key classification

excluded: legacy RabbitMQ payloads and dead letters
claim: observable logical absence within the declared checked scope; no irreversible or universal erasure claim
